svg.title: Where files are stored
svg.desc: Firestore holds only metadata with AssetRefs. Supabase private-media holds every user file under the owner's prefix. The DGX keeps weights, staging and caches locally. The app holds bundled lessons and caches.

span.p: AssetRef: bucket, objectKey, sha256, byteSize, contentType
